mappings.note: The mirror's radius and OA come from the right triangle at the point of contact (LO-2); reaching that triangle first needs AO to bisect the 60 degrees and to bisect chord PQ, which follows from AP = AQ (LO-3).

Parts (iv) and (v) are the mappable mathematics: BD = BF and DC = CE let the sides of ABC be assembled from equal tangent segments together with area = r times s. Parts (i)-(iii) ask only the CIRCUMFERENCE and AREA of the circle, which belong to the areas-related-to-circles goal and have no outcome anywhere in this chapter's frame.
